summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review repaired the malformed activity layer from XML Tables 1-6, reconciled DBAASP MIC/FICI rows against primary tables, preserved unmatched MBIC database rows as explicit cautions, and closed the prior framework-only rework ticket only after strict gates passed.

unavailable_sources: No local supplementary assets beyond the PMC OA package were present; source package contains NXML/PDF and figure images only.
materials_exhausted.note: All local materials that can change worker-2/4/6 gate status were opened: XML tables, PDF text, OA package manifest/members, figure captions/images, linked database rows, and sequence catalog rows.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP MIC and FICI rows are source-verified against primary XML Tables 1 and 2 when values match; MBIC absolute concentration rows remain source_conflict because local primary material reports biofilm results as MECBF ratios/FECIs, not matching absolute MBIC rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Activity/toxicity evidence is now table-backed: MIC, FICI, MECBF, MECH, MECF, and Table 5/6 toxicity-combination FECI rows all have primary XML locators and non-generic endpoints.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to paper-supported context and direct figure assays; qualitative figure support is preserved without inventing numeric time-course values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_publication_grade: No blocking or major worker-2/4/6 issue remains if strict gates pass; database MBIC mismatch is a preserved caution rather than hidden acceptance.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Twelve mirrored DBAASP MBIC rows remain source_conflict across assay and experiment snapshots; no exact absolute MBIC primary row exists in XML/PDF/package, while Table 3/Table 4 biofilm values are separately captured.
Figures 1-2 are available as images/captions and support qualitative mechanism assay classes, but no local numeric time-course table is present.
